title: IronNathanAlvares/leafline
description: A crop-disease inference service on Kubernetes: a three-tier inference ladder, GPU scheduling, KEDA autoscaling on queue depth rather than CPU, and warm headroom for a cold start you cannot scale away. M1 of 6 is built and CI-verified; the rest is designed.
